name.en: GT2 20-tooth pulley, 9 mm belt, 5 mm bore
name.es: Polea GT2 de 20 dientes, banda de 9 mm, barreno de 5 mm
name.fr: Poulie GT2 à 20 dents, courroie de 9 mm, alésage de 5 mm
name.pt: Polia GT2 de 20 dentes, correia de 9 mm, furo de 5 mm

description.en: A flanged GT2 (2GT) timing pulley with 20 teeth for a 9 mm belt and a 5 mm set-screw bore. A commercial class: the tooth count, pitch, pitch diameter and bore are shared; the hub and flange dimensions are one maker's (MISUMI GPA, shape A). In a Voron 2.4-class Z drive it sits on the 5 mm output shaft and drives the 9 mm Z belt.
description.es: Una polea síncrona GT2 (2GT) con pestañas, de 20 dientes para banda de 9 mm y barreno de 5 mm con prisioneros. Una clase comercial: el número de dientes, el paso, el diámetro primitivo y el barreno son comunes; las medidas del cubo y las pestañas son de un fabricante (MISUMI GPA, forma A). En un accionamiento Z de clase Voron 2.4 va en la flecha de salida de 5 mm y mueve la banda Z de 9 mm.
description.fr: Une poulie crantée GT2 (2GT) à flasques, à 20 dents pour courroie de 9 mm et alésage de 5 mm à vis de pression. Une classe commerciale : le nombre de dents, le pas, le diamètre primitif et l'alésage sont communs ; les cotes du moyeu et des flasques sont celles d'un fabricant (MISUMI GPA, forme A). Dans un entraînement Z de classe Voron 2.4, elle est montée sur l'arbre de sortie de 5 mm et entraîne la courroie Z de 9 mm.
description.pt: Uma polia sincronizada GT2 (2GT) com flanges, de 20 dentes para correia de 9 mm e furo de 5 mm com parafusos de fixação. Uma classe comercial: o número de dentes, o passo, o diâmetro primitivo e o furo são comuns; as medidas do cubo e das flanges são de um fabricante (MISUMI GPA, forma A). Num acionamento Z de classe Voron 2.4 vai no eixo de saída de 5 mm e move a correia Z de 9 mm.

governing.designation: GT2 (2GT) 20-tooth timing pulley for 9 mm belt, 5 mm bore

sources.title: MISUMI High Torque Timing Pulleys, 2GT type (GPA□□GT2040 / GT2060 / GT2090), catalog page 1340 (2019 MX)
sources.supports: 2GT, pitch 2.0 mm. Number of teeth vs P.D./O.D.: 16 teeth P.D. 10.19, O.D. 9.68; 20 teeth P.D. 12.73, O.D. 12.22. Belt width 6 mm (GPA□□GT2060): A 7.0, W 10.3, L 18.0; belt width 9 mm (GPA□□GT2090): A 10.0, W 13.3, L 21.0 (A shape: the hub, then the flanged toothed section W, 1.65 each side of A). Shaft bore 5 (H7) with M3 tapped holes and M3 x 3 set screws.

sources.title: POWGE / Gates Voron 2.4 motion set (retailer listing, West3D)
sources.supports: Voron 2.4 motion set: GT2 open belt LL-2GT-9 (9 mm wide, Gates); GT2 belt loop 6 mm wide, 188 mm, 4 pcs (Gates); GT2 16T pulley, 5 mm bore, 4 pcs; GT2 20T pulley 9 mm wide, 5 mm bore, 4 pcs; GT2 80T pulley 6 mm wide, 5 mm bore, 4 pcs; 625 2RS bearings, 12 pcs; 5 × 60 mm shaft with ground flat, 4 pcs

sources.title: Voron 2.4r2 build guide, version 2023-07-04 (VoronDesign/Voron-2 @ a192410, Manual/Assembly_Manual_2.4r2.pdf, GPL-3.0); cited by page and section only, nothing copied
sources.supports: p. 32 (Z Drives and Idlers, belt drive assembly): a GT2 20T 9 mm wide pulley on the 5x60 shaft, one set screw on the D cut; p. 111 (Z axis): the Z belt is GT2, 9 mm wide

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of end face A, the hub end, on the bore axis. +z runs along the bore through the hub and then the flanged toothed section to end face B, the flange end, at z = 21 (MISUMI GPA, 9 mm belt, shape A: L 21, W 13.3). The belt's mid-plane is the middle of the toothed section, z = 14.35. +x is an arbitrary radial reference: the pulley is round, so both interfaces have continuous symmetry.

toothed_section_width.note: MISUMI W: the toothed width plus 1.65 each side

belt_midplane_from_face_a.note: derived: L − W/2 (shape A is the hub, L − W = 7.7, then the toothed section W with the belt centred in it)

set_screw.note: M3 x 3 set screws for the 5 mm bore

label.en: Bore at the hub end (face A)
label.es: Barreno en el extremo del cubo (cara A)
label.pt: Furo no lado do cubo (face A)

interfaces.note: Female: the bore takes the shaft hub end first. Framed at face A (the hub end), normal −z out of that face, so a shaft framed where face A lands, its normal toward the pulley, puts the pulley beyond it. The bore carries the Z drive's shaft-hub key (z-drive-pulley-hub-5mm): a set-screw hub on a Ø5 D-cut shaft.

label.en: Bore at the flange end (face B)
label.es: Barreno en el extremo de la pestaña (cara B)
label.pt: Furo no lado da flange (face B)

interfaces.note: Female: the same bore entered flange end first (the pulley turned round). Framed at face B, z = 21, normal +z out of that face.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P6-ZBED lane, 2026-10-04); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: Belt engagement (for ASM-1 §9 belt paths, lifted into belt_engagement when that block exists): pitch_diameter 12.73 mm, centre (0, 0, 14.35), axis (0, 0, 1); the mid-plane is derived from MISUMI's L and W, not a single cited number. Not interchangeable with gt2-pulley-20t-5mm, which is the 6 mm-belt pulley for a motor shaft.
